# OPTIONS: every drive-view option, where it is declared, set, read, gated and tested

Written 2026-10-22 on branch docs/inventory (base main f52ed8a); the option table's registry columns are now GENERATED (feat/option-registry, 2026-10-22).

**Status (registry landed):** the options are declared once in `js/options-registry.js`. The table below is regenerated by `node docs/inventory/scripts/gen-options-docs.js` (`--check` reports a stale file); the columns id, kind, group, cost class, default, requires / ignored when / conflicts and owner come from the registry, and the rules they name are listed under "Rules the registry declares". All other columns, and everything outside the `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->` blocks, are hand-written and carried over by option id. Line numbers in the hand-written text are from f52ed8a and may have drifted a few lines.
Labels: OBSERVED = read in the file at the cited line (or computed by a command); INFERRED = deduced from code, not run. No browser was run.

## How an option flows (OBSERVED)

1. Declared once in the registry (js/options-registry.js; 87 saved keys plus the extra, derived, session and game entries). `DV_DEF` in js/spec-ui.js is `RF.Options.defaults()`. Loaded by `dvOpts(ui)` (spec-ui.js): the saved profile goes through `RF.Options.migrateProfile` first (frozen defaults, see 4), then `Object.assign({}, DV_DEF, profile)`, then the migrations listed in the Migration column.
2. Written by `setDV(ui, k, v)` (spec-ui.js:907-911): sets `dvOpts(ui)[k]`, writes the WHOLE object back to localStorage `flux/driveView`, calls `ui.redrawSpec()`. Quiet variant (no redraw) is the `setDV(u,k,v,true)` passed to DriveAnim (spec-ui.js:1139) used by the speed slider (drive-anim.js:1584).
3. Read by `drawDrive` (spec-ui.js:1125) -> `cpuStill` (CPU picture, key at :1074) and `RF.DriveAnim.sync(ui, cv, {o: dvOpts(ui), ...})` (spec-ui.js:1139; drive-anim.js:2161) -> `prepare()` (drive-anim.js:1150) builds `V.p` (the per-frame parameter bag, :1159) and `V.src` (scene source) from `o`. The GPU side reads `V.p.look` (drive-three.js `update`, :215).
4. Because setDV saves the whole object, **every DV_DEF key is frozen into a user's localStorage at their first save**. A later change of a DV_DEF default never reaches that user (the code says so itself at spec-ui.js:890: "Old setDV saved the whole option set, so onKcd = 30 is the old default, not a choice"). OBSERVED. Consequence: new defaults (e.g. `samples` 1, `lampHalos` off) are only seen by fresh profiles, `?reset` or `?safe`.
   **Fixed on feat/option-registry (H2):** each registry entry may carry a `defaultHistory`, and a saved profile carries `defaultsVersion`. On load, a whole-object profile saved before the current version takes the new default for every key whose value equals a superseded default (seeded from the git log: `tiles`, `glare`, `gpuRenderer`, `reflectiveClothing`); any other value is the user's choice and stays. The file is still written whole; storing only changed keys is the next step (see the report).
5. In game mode `sync()` runs `Object.assign(I.o, st.gameOptions)` (drive-anim.js:2163) on the same live object; see HAZARDS.md H1.

## URL / query parameters that touch the drive view (grep of `location.`, `URLSearchParams`; OBSERVED)

| param | where read | effect |
|---|---|---|
| `?reset` (query or `#reset`) | js/ui.js:36-43 | removes localStorage `flux/driveView` before the Drive view reads it; also turns safe mode on (`ui.safeMode`, ui.js:38) |
| `?safe` (query or `#safe`) | js/ui.js:36-43 | same clear of `flux/driveView`; safe mode: no auto solve (ui.js:70,555,593), rays capped to 100000 (ui.js:2065), banner (ui.js:2070) |
| `?halobins=N` | js/drive-three-halo.js:29 | seeds module-level `HALO_N` (clamped 4..32). `HALO_URL_N` is used only when `look.haloBins` is null (drive-three-halo.js:167). With DV_DEF.haloBins = 24 it is never null, so the URL value is overwritten at the first halo build (INFERRED from code; not run) |
| unfinished boot flag `flux/booting` | js/ui.js:31-33,38 | safe mode only; does NOT clear `flux/driveView` (driveRescue excludes it, ui.js:37) |

**In-page reset (no URL):** the "Reset drive settings" button (`#ab-reset-drive`, js/compare-ui.js, next to the Solve cache bar; visible only in spec mode via `body.mode-D` in css/app.css) removes localStorage `flux/driveView` after a confirm step and reloads at `location.pathname` with no query or hash, so safe mode stays off and no banner shows. It leaves `flux/driveMore`, `flux/driveAirAdv`, `flux/driveHaloAdv`, `flux/roadView`, the saved scene and the beam library untouched. Test: tests/regress/RESET-DRIVE-SETTINGS.js.

Not found: any other query/hash parameter in js/*.js or index.html (`grep -n "location\." js/*.js index.html` returns only the five sites above plus `location.protocol` at drive-anim.js:2154, which forces the CPU fallback on `file:`).

Test/debug globals that change rendering (OBSERVED by grep, set by tests or the console, no UI): `SL_HALO_DIV` (drive-three-halo.js:93), `SL_HALO_POLAR` (:186), `SL_HALO_SUB` (:228,247), `SL_HALO_TIMING` (:159,207), `HALO_TABLE_ONLY` (:254), `SD_TABLE_BUDGET_MS` (drive-three.js:150), `SD_SCATTER` (stats object, drive-three.js:73), `RF.SpecUI.forceCpuStill` (spec-ui.js:1103), `Wk.forced` (drive-anim.js:1253), `V.pinSS` (drive-anim.js:1199, freezes supersampling and dynamic scale).

## Other localStorage keys the drive view uses (OBSERVED, `grep getItem/setItem`)

`flux/driveView` (all options), `flux/driveMore`, `flux/driveAirAdv`, `flux/driveHaloAdv` (collapsed-group UI state, spec-ui.js:989-997), `flux/roadView` (rvOpts: road shape and Road-view scale; the drive view reads `rv.shape` for the bend), `flux/ffView`. `?reset`/`?safe` clear only `flux/driveView`.

## Option table

Columns: **id .. owner** (generated) = from the registry; **default** is the DV_DEF value. **Readers (js/)** = files with a read of the option through an options object (`o.`, `.o.`, `look.`, `opts.`, `p.`, `flags.`) plus first line numbers; counts are lines, computed by script (method at the end). **Tests** = test files that SET the option (setDV/setOwn/control selector/non-baseline assignment; a line that lists 5 or more option keys is treated as a baseline reset and not counted) with `G` marking membership in the curated gate (40 tests, `node tests/gate.js --full --list`). For the generic-word keys (scene, seed, speed, res, tex, mt, wild, density, fov, ev, smooth, samples, playing, wet, view, glare, cline, scatter, ambient, tiles) a test line only counts if it also names dvOpts/setDV/setOwn/setOpt/data-dv/data-anim/`.o.`, so these lists are a LOWER bound; the other keys use the looser rule and are an upper bound. Cost class is quoted only where the code or tooltip says so; otherwise "-".

| scatterBinCounts, scatterNearBias, scatterQuality | scatterMode == table | hidden (spec-ui.js:1036,1040,1041) | override air level counts in table mode only |
| scatterCycle | table AND scatterCache on | disabled (spec-ui.js:1042) | effective cycle = cache && value==8 (drive-three.js:137) |
| scatterCycleFade | scatterCycle == 8, table, cache | hidden/disabled (spec-ui.js:1043) | single bank shown |
| scatterGain | table (tooltip) | no cue; sits in the HALO group (drive-anim.js:1660) | multiplies a lookup that does not exist in direct mode |
| trafficHalo (effective) | trafficBeams on (haloN drive.js:819) | NO cue: the select shows whenever air is on | silent no-op |
| haloPolar, haloPolarLamps, haloBins, haloDiv, haloGain | trafficHalo > 0 | no cue | no halo to modify |
| trafficLightRange, trafficNearest | trafficBeams on (lightRangeOf feeds p.lightRange, used by traffic beams) | no cue | no road light from traffic |
| trafficOutIds | trafficShuffle == library | no cue | pool null |
| trafficShuffle | symmetric oncoming; saved low beams; <= 16 on GPU | tooltip only (drive-anim.js:1536-1538) | built-in beams |
| onKcd | onMode == manual | label says "Manual mode only"; not disabled | ignored (still used to build the template car lamps, drive-anim.js:60) |
| wetSheen | wetness > 0 | disabled (spec-ui.js:1018) | - |
| wetModel | wetness > 0 AND wetSheen | disabled (spec-ui.js:1019) | - |
| lampHalos | GPU renderer | tooltip only | CPU ignores it |
| lampClass | lampHalos on or lampRoad table | no cue | no effect |
| lampRoad | street lamps present (tiles+streetLamps, or pass); GPU or CPU live view | no cue | no effect |
| tileCache | tiles on | disabled (drive-anim.js:1880) - does not allow the pass | - |
| streetLamps | tiles or mountainPass | disabled (drive-anim.js:1881) | - |
| seed, dice | wild road, OR traffic on, OR tiles, OR leafy road/forest | disabled (drive-anim.js:1886) | - |
| density | wild road OR leafy road/forest | disabled (drive-anim.js:1887) | the pass still uses it for tree spacing (drive-touge.js:116) |
| cline | US preset | disabled (drive-anim.js:1888) | - |
| safeGap | trafficLogic off | disabled (drive-anim.js:1879) | - |
| mt (threads) | CPU renderer; none of mountainPass, trafficBeams, library shuffle, surfaceSheen, lampPitch, afs, corneringLamps; not in game | button disabled only when Worker missing (drive-anim.js:1891) | silently single thread (drive-anim.js:1264) |
| dynamicResolution + minFps/frameTargetMs | dynamicResolution on | no cue | minFps unused when off |
| leafyFoliage | scene road or forest, not the pass | no cue | ignored on pass and city (drive-anim.js:35) |
| people | not the pass | no cue | pass builds no people regardless |
| expMode auto/adapt | - | - | forces the ~2.5 s CPU still on every redraw (spec-ui.js:1103) -> option changes become slow again |
| gpuRenderer off | - | - | disables every GPU-only option at once: halos, lampHalos, mesh cars/trees, mountain-pass elevation, table air beam |
| mountainPass | GPU for elevation | status line (drive-anim.js:2182) | CPU fallback is the flat road |
| airLevel / haloQuality | - | derived dropdown shows "custom" when options are hand-edited | bundle options silently drift apart |

## Method (reproducible)

- Option list: `js/options-registry.js` (before the registry: the DV_DEF literal on line 840 of js/spec-ui.js, 87 keys). Extra keys were found by a regex sweep of `o.`/`.o.`/`opts.`/`look.` property names and `setDV(ui, 'key'` calls in the drive files and compared with DV_DEF.
- Readers: per key, regex `(o|.o|I.o|dvOpts(..)|opts|look|p|src|flags|cfg|opt|V.p|gameOptions).KEY` or `["KEY"]` over js/drive*.js, spec-ui.js, ui.js, scene-details.js, lamp-dist.js, beams.js, beam-atlas.js, table-pace.js. Counts are matching LINES.
- Tests: 243 .js files under tests/ (fixtures, bench, tools and touge-proto-runner excluded). A line counts as setting the key if it matches setDV/setOwn/`data-dv|data-anim=`kebab-name/`dvOpts.KEY =`/a helper call `(page, "KEY", ...)`/`KEY:` with fewer than 5 DV keys on the line. Gate membership from `node tests/gate.js --full --list` (40 entries).
- `docs/inventory/scripts/options-scan.js` reproduces the reader/test scan (input: the output of `node tests/gate.js --full --list`). The tables in this file were rendered from that scan plus hand-written metadata (control, gating, cost, migration columns) that is not committed as code. The regexes are approximate: a missed reader or test is possible. A claim of "none" was checked by hand for onDist, preDist, smooth (grep of tests/ and js/ gave no hit outside spec-ui.js:1074-1079 and the sidebar row for smooth).
